       IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. SMALL-NNUM.

       ENVIRONMENT DIVISION.

       INPUT-OUTPUT SECTION.

       DATA DIVISION.

       LINKAGE SECTION.

       01 LINKED-ITEMS.
           05 L-LIST1 OCCURS 11 TIMES INDEXED BY NI PIC S9(10).
           05 L-N PIC S9(10).
           05 RESULT OCCURS 100 TIMES INDEXED BY NJ PIC S9(10).

      * Write a function to get the n smallest items from a dataset.
      * >>> small_nnum([10, 20, 50, 70, 90, 20, 50, 40, 60, 80, 100], 2)
      * [10, 20]
      *

      * Complete the WORKING-STORAGE SECTION and the PROCEDURE DIVISION
      * Store the result in the RESULT variable and mark the end of your program with END PROGRAM

       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01 WS-LIST.
           05 WS-ITEM OCCURS 11 TIMES PIC S9(10).
       01 WS-I PIC 9(4).
       01 WS-J PIC 9(4).
       01 WS-N PIC S9(10).
       01 WS-TEMP PIC S9(10).

       PROCEDURE DIVISION USING LINKED-ITEMS.
      * Copy the input list into working storage
           PERFORM VARYING WS-I FROM 1 BY 1 UNTIL WS-I > 11
               MOVE L-LIST1(WS-I) TO WS-ITEM(WS-I)
           END-PERFORM

      * Sort the copy in ascending order (bubble sort)
           PERFORM VARYING WS-I FROM 1 BY 1 UNTIL WS-I > 10
               PERFORM VARYING WS-J FROM 1 BY 1 UNTIL WS-J > 10
                   IF WS-ITEM(WS-J) > WS-ITEM(WS-J + 1)
                       MOVE WS-ITEM(WS-J) TO WS-TEMP
                       MOVE WS-ITEM(WS-J + 1) TO WS-ITEM(WS-J)
                       MOVE WS-TEMP TO WS-ITEM(WS-J + 1)
                   END-IF
               END-PERFORM
           END-PERFORM

      * Determine how many items to return (at most 11)
           IF L-N > 11
               MOVE 11 TO WS-N
           ELSE
               MOVE L-N TO WS-N
           END-IF

      * Move the N smallest items into RESULT
           PERFORM VARYING WS-I FROM 1 BY 1 UNTIL WS-I > WS-N
               MOVE WS-ITEM(WS-I) TO RESULT(WS-I)
           END-PERFORM

           GOBACK.
       END PROGRAM SMALL-NNUM.

      * Write a function to check if a string represents an integer or not.

       MAIN-PARA.
           MOVE 0 TO RESULT
           MOVE L-TEXT TO WS-TEXT

      * Determine length ignoring trailing spaces
           MOVE 100 TO WS-LEN
           PERFORM UNTIL WS-LEN = 0
              IF WS-TEXT(WS-LEN:1) = SPACE
                 SUBTRACT 1 FROM WS-LEN
              ELSE
                 EXIT PERFORM
              END-IF
           END-PERFORM

           IF WS-LEN = 0
              GOBACK
           END-IF

      * Skip any leading spaces
           MOVE 1 TO WS-START
           PERFORM UNTIL WS-START > WS-LEN
              IF WS-TEXT(WS-START:1) = SPACE
                 ADD 1 TO WS-START
              ELSE
                 EXIT PERFORM
              END-IF
           END-PERFORM

           IF WS-START > WS-LEN
              GOBACK
           END-IF

      * Allow one optional leading sign
           MOVE WS-START TO WS-I
           IF WS-TEXT(WS-I:1) = '+' OR WS-TEXT(WS-I:1) = '-'
              ADD 1 TO WS-I
           END-IF

      * At least one digit must remain

      * >>> reverse_vowels('Python')
      * 'Python'
      *

      * Complete the WORKING-STORAGE SECTION and the PROCEDURE DIVISION
      * Store the result in the RESULT variable and mark the end of your program with END PROGRAM

       PROCEDURE DIVISION USING LINKED-ITEMS.
           MOVE L-STR1 TO WS-STR
      * Determine effective length, ignoring trailing spaces
           MOVE 0 TO WS-LEN
           PERFORM VARYING WS-K FROM 100 BY -1
               UNTIL WS-K < 1 OR WS-LEN > 0
               IF WS-CHAR(WS-K) NOT = SPACE
                   MOVE WS-K TO WS-LEN
               END-IF
           END-PERFORM
      * Two-pointer scan, swapping vowels from both ends
           MOVE 1 TO WS-I
           MOVE WS-LEN TO WS-J
           PERFORM UNTIL WS-I >= WS-J
               PERFORM UNTIL WS-I >= WS-J
                   OR WS-CHAR(WS-I) = "a" OR "e" OR "i" OR "o"
                      OR "u" OR "A" OR "E" OR "I" OR "O" OR "U"
                   ADD 1 TO WS-I
               END-PERFORM
               PERFORM UNTIL WS-J <= WS-I
                   OR WS-CHAR(WS-J) = "a" OR "e" OR "i" OR "o"
                      OR "u" OR "A" OR "E" OR "I" OR "O" OR "U"
                   SUBTRACT 1 FROM WS-J
               END-PERFORM
               IF WS-I < WS-J
                   MOVE WS-CHAR(WS-I) TO WS-TMP
                   MOVE WS-CHAR(WS-J) TO WS-CHAR(WS-I)
                   MOVE WS-TMP TO WS-CHAR(WS-J)
                   ADD 1 TO WS-I
                   SUBTRACT 1 FROM WS-J

      * Write a function to sort a list of elements using pancake sort.
      * >>> pancake_sort([15, 79, 25, 38, 69])
      * [15, 25, 38, 69, 79]

       PROCEDURE DIVISION USING LINKED-ITEMS.

       MAIN-LOGIC.
      * Copy input numbers into working storage
           PERFORM VARYING WS-I FROM 1 BY 1 UNTIL WS-I > 5
               MOVE L-NUMS(WS-I) TO WS-NUM(WS-I)
           END-PERFORM

      * Pancake sort: repeatedly move the largest unsorted element
      * to its final position using two prefix flips
           PERFORM VARYING WS-SIZE FROM 5 BY -1 UNTIL WS-SIZE < 2
      * Find the index of the maximum in WS-NUM(1..WS-SIZE)
               MOVE 1 TO WS-MAX-IDX
               PERFORM VARYING WS-I FROM 2 BY 1 UNTIL WS-I > WS-SIZE
                   IF WS-NUM(WS-I) > WS-NUM(WS-MAX-IDX)
                       MOVE WS-I TO WS-MAX-IDX
                   END-IF
               END-PERFORM
      * Flip max to the front, then flip it into its final place
               IF WS-MAX-IDX NOT = WS-SIZE
                   MOVE WS-MAX-IDX TO WS-J
                   PERFORM FLIP-PREFIX
                   MOVE WS-SIZE TO WS-J
                   PERFORM FLIP-PREFIX
               END-IF
           END-PERFORM

      * Copy the sorted numbers into RESULT
           PERFORM VARYING WS-I FROM 1 BY 1 UNTIL WS-I > 5
               MOVE WS-NUM(WS-I) TO RESULT(WS-I)
           END-PERFORM
           GOBACK.

      * Reverse the elements WS-NUM(1..WS-J)
       FLIP-PREFIX.
           MOVE WS-J TO WS-K
           PERFORM VARYING WS-I FROM 1 BY 1 UNTIL WS-I >= WS-K
               MOVE WS-NUM(WS-I) TO WS-TEMP
               MOVE WS-NUM(WS-K) TO WS-NUM(WS-I)
               MOVE WS-TEMP TO WS-NUM(WS-K)
               SUBTRACT 1 FROM WS-K
           END-PERFORM.

      * Digit DP over the decimal digits of N (least significant first).
      * State = carry into the current position when adding the two parts.
      * For each digit we try every digit of the first part; the digit of
      * the second part is then fixed modulo 10.

                   ADD 1 TO WS-LEN
                   DIVIDE WS-TEMP BY 10 GIVING WS-TEMP
                       REMAINDER WS-DIGIT(WS-LEN)
               END-PERFORM
           END-IF

           MOVE -1 TO WS-DP1
           PERFORM VARYING WS-I FROM 1 BY 1 UNTIL WS-I > WS-LEN

                       IF WS-SUM > 9

                       IF WS-Y < 0

                       COMPUTE WS-SUM = WS-X + WS-Y + 1

       IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. TEXT-LOWERCASE-UNDERSCORE.

       ENVIRONMENT DIVISION.

       DATA DIVISION.

       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.

       01 WS-VARS.
           05 WS-I            PIC 9(3) VALUE 0.
           05 WS-LEN          PIC 9(3) VALUE 0.
           05 WS-UNDERSCORES  PIC 9(3) VALUE 0.
           05 WS-LOW-BEFORE   PIC 9(3) VALUE 0.
           05 WS-LOW-AFTER    PIC 9(3) VALUE 0.
           05 WS-VALID        PIC X    VALUE 'Y'.

       LINKAGE SECTION.

       01 LINKED-ITEMS.
           05 L-TEXT PIC X(100).
           05 RESULT PIC X(100).

       PROCEDURE DIVISION USING LINKED-ITEMS.

       MAIN-LOGIC.
      * Find the effective length of the text (ignore trailing spaces)
           MOVE 0 TO WS-LEN
           PERFORM VARYING WS-I FROM 1 BY 1 UNTIL WS-I > 100
               IF L-TEXT(WS-I:1) NOT = SPACE
                   MOVE WS-I TO WS-LEN
               END-IF
           END-PERFORM

      * Validate: one or more lowercase letters, one underscore,
      * then one or more lowercase letters, and nothing else
           MOVE 0 TO WS-UNDERSCORES
           MOVE 0 TO WS-LOW-BEFORE
           MOVE 0 TO WS-LOW-AFTER
           MOVE 'Y' TO WS-VALID

           PERFORM VARYING WS-I FROM 1 BY 1 UNTIL WS-I > WS-LEN
               EVALUATE TRUE
                   WHEN L-TEXT(WS-I:1) IS ALPHABETIC-LOWER
                       IF WS-UNDERSCORES = 0
                           ADD 1 TO WS-LOW-BEFORE
                       ELSE
                           ADD 1 TO WS-LOW-AFTER
                       END-IF
                   WHEN L-TEXT(WS-I:1) = '_'
                       ADD 1 TO WS-UNDERSCORES
                   WHEN OTHER
                       MOVE 'N' TO WS-VALID
               END-EVALUATE
           END-PERFORM

           IF WS-VALID = 'Y'
               AND WS-UNDERSCORES = 1
               AND WS-LOW-BEFORE > 0
               AND WS-LOW-AFTER > 0
               MOVE 'Found a match!' TO RESULT
           ELSE
               MOVE 'No match!' TO RESULT
           END-IF

           GOBACK.

       END PROGRAM TEXT-LOWERCASE-UNDERSCORE.

      * Write a function to find if the given number is a keith number or not.
      * >>> is_num_keith(14)
      * True

       PROCEDURE DIVISION USING LINKED-ITEMS.
           MOVE 0 TO RESULT
           COMPUTE WS-NUM = FUNCTION ABS(L-X)

      * Single-digit numbers are not Keith numbers
           IF WS-NUM < 10
               GOBACK
           END-IF

      * Extract the digits (least significant first)
           MOVE WS-NUM TO WS-TEMP
           MOVE 0 TO WS-COUNT
           PERFORM UNTIL WS-TEMP = 0
               DIVIDE WS-TEMP BY 10 GIVING WS-QUOT REMAINDER WS-REM
               ADD 1 TO WS-COUNT
               MOVE WS-REM TO WS-DIGIT(WS-COUNT)
               MOVE WS-QUOT TO WS-TEMP
           END-PERFORM

      * Seed the sequence with the digits in their original order
           PERFORM VARYING WS-I FROM 1 BY 1 UNTIL WS-I > WS-COUNT
               MOVE WS-DIGIT(WS-COUNT - WS-I + 1) TO WS-TERM(WS-I)
           END-PERFORM

      * Generate the Fibonacci-like digit sequence
           MOVE 0 TO WS-DONE
           PERFORM UNTIL WS-DONE = 1
               MOVE 0 TO WS-SUM
               PERFORM VARYING WS-I FROM 1 BY 1 UNTIL WS-I > WS-COUNT
                   ADD WS-TERM(WS-I) TO WS-SUM
               END-PERFORM
               IF WS-SUM = WS-NUM
                   MOVE 1 TO RESULT
                   MOVE 1 TO WS-DONE
               ELSE
                   IF WS-SUM > WS-NUM
                       MOVE 1 TO WS-DONE
                   ELSE
                       PERFORM VARYING WS-I FROM 1 BY 1
                           UNTIL WS-I >= WS-COUNT
                           MOVE WS-TERM(WS-I + 1) TO WS-TERM(WS-I)
                       END-PERFORM
                       MOVE WS-SUM TO WS-TERM(WS-COUNT)
                   END-IF
               END-IF
           END-PERFORM

           GOBACK.

               GOBACK

           MOVE WS-X TO WS-TEMP

               DIVIDE WS-TEMP BY 10 GIVING WS-QUOT REMAINDER WS-REM

       PROGRAM-ID. IS-NOT-PRIME.

       ENVIRONMENT DIVISION.

       INPUT-OUTPUT SECTION.

       DATA DIVISION.

       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01 WS-I          PIC S9(10).
       01 WS-Q          PIC S9(10).
       01 WS-REM        PIC S9(10).

       LINKAGE SECTION.

       01 LINKED-ITEMS.
           05 L-N PIC S9(10).
           05 RESULT PIC 9.

      * Write a python function to identify non-prime numbers.
      * >>> is_not_prime(2)
      * False
      *
      * RESULT is 1 when L-N is not prime, 0 when it is prime.

       PROCEDURE DIVISION USING LINKED-ITEMS.
           IF L-N < 2
               MOVE 1 TO RESULT
           ELSE
               MOVE 0 TO RESULT
               MOVE 2 TO WS-I
               PERFORM UNTIL WS-I * WS-I > L-N OR RESULT = 1
                   DIVIDE L-N BY WS-I GIVING WS-Q REMAINDER WS-REM
                   IF WS-REM = 0
                       MOVE 1 TO RESULT
                   END-IF
                   ADD 1 TO WS-I
               END-PERFORM
           END-IF
           GOBACK.
       END PROGRAM IS-NOT-PRIME.

       IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. MAX-SUM-INCREASING-SUBSEQ.

       ENVIRONMENT DIVISION.

       INPUT-OUTPUT SECTION.

       DATA DIVISION.

       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01 WS-VARS.
           05 WS-J PIC S9(10).
           05 WS-P PIC S9(10).
           05 WS-LIMIT PIC S9(10).
           05 WS-TARGET PIC S9(10).
           05 WS-BEST PIC S9(10).
           05 WS-CAND PIC S9(10).
       01 WS-DP-TABLE.
           05 WS-DP OCCURS 7 TIMES PIC S9(10).

       LINKAGE SECTION.

       01 LINKED-ITEMS.
           05 L-A OCCURS 7 TIMES INDEXED BY NI PIC S9(10).
           05 L-N PIC S9(10).
           05 L-INDEX PIC S9(10).
           05 L-K PIC S9(10).
           05 RESULT PIC S9(10).

       PROCEDURE DIVISION USING LINKED-ITEMS.
           MOVE 0 TO RESULT
           IF L-N <= 0 OR L-INDEX < 0 OR L-K <= L-INDEX
              OR L-K >= L-N
              GOBACK
           END-IF
           COMPUTE WS-TARGET = L-A(L-K + 1)
           COMPUTE WS-LIMIT = L-INDEX + 1
           MOVE 0 TO WS-BEST
           PERFORM VARYING WS-J FROM 1 BY 1 UNTIL WS-J > WS-LIMIT
               IF L-A(WS-J) < WS-TARGET
                   MOVE L-A(WS-J) TO WS-DP(WS-J)
               ELSE
                   MOVE 0 TO WS-DP(WS-J)
               END-IF
           END-PERFORM
           PERFORM VARYING WS-J FROM 1 BY 1 UNTIL WS-J > WS-LIMIT
               IF L-A(WS-J) < WS-TARGET
                   PERFORM VARYING WS-P FROM 1 BY 1
                       UNTIL WS-P >= WS-J
                       IF L-A(WS-P) < L-A(WS-J)
                           COMPUTE WS-CAND =
                               WS-DP(WS-P) + L-A(WS-J)
                           IF WS-CAND > WS-DP(WS-J)
                               MOVE WS-CAND TO WS-DP(WS-J)
                           END-IF
                       END-IF
                   END-PERFORM
                   IF WS-DP(WS-J) > WS-BEST
                       MOVE WS-DP(WS-J) TO WS-BEST
                   END-IF
               END-IF
           END-PERFORM
           COMPUTE RESULT = WS-BEST + WS-TARGET
           GOBACK.
       END PROGRAM MAX-SUM-INCREASING-SUBSEQ.

       DATA DIVISION.

           05 WS-DP OCCURS 7 TIMES PIC S9(18).
           05 WS-J PIC 9(4).
           05 WS-M PIC 9(4).
           05 WS-LIMIT PIC S9(10).
           05 WS-KIDX PIC S9(10).
           05 WS-BEST PIC S9(18).

       LINKAGE SECTION.

       01 LINKED-ITEMS.
           05 L-A OCCURS 7 TIMES INDEXED BY NI PIC S9(10).
           05 L-N PIC S9(10).
           05 L-INDEX PIC S9(10).
           05 L-K PIC S9(10).
           05 RESULT PIC S9(10).

      * Write a function to find the maximum sum of increasing subsequence from prefix till ith
      * index and also including a given kth element which is after i, i.e., k > i .
      * >>> max_sum_increasing_subseq([1, 101, 2, 3, 100, 4, 5], 7, 4, 6)
      * 11
      *

       PROCEDURE DIVISION USING LINKED-ITEMS.

      * L-INDEX and L-K are 0-based; convert to 1-based table positions
           COMPUTE WS-LIMIT = L-INDEX + 1
           COMPUTE WS-KIDX = L-K + 1

      * WS-DP(j) = max sum of increasing subsequence ending at j,
      * computed over the prefix 1 .. i+1
           PERFORM VARYING WS-J FROM 1 BY 1 UNTIL WS-J > WS-LIMIT
               MOVE L-A(WS-J) TO WS-DP(WS-J)
               PERFORM VARYING WS-M FROM 1 BY 1 UNTIL WS-M >= WS-J
                   IF L-A(WS-M) < L-A(WS-J)
                       IF WS-DP(WS-M) + L-A(WS-J) > WS-DP(WS-J)
                           COMPUTE WS-DP(WS-J) =
                               WS-DP(WS-M) + L-A(WS-J)
                       END-IF
                   END-IF
               END-PERFORM
           END-PERFORM

      * Best prefix subsequence whose last element is smaller than a(k)
           MOVE 0 TO WS-BEST
           PERFORM VARYING WS-J FROM 1 BY 1 UNTIL WS-J > WS-LIMIT
               IF L-A(WS-J) < L-A(WS-KIDX)
                   IF WS-DP(WS-J) > WS-BEST
                       MOVE WS-DP(WS-J) TO WS-BEST
                   END-IF
               END-IF
           END-PERFORM

      * Append the kth element
           COMPUTE RESULT = WS-BEST + L-A(WS-KIDX)

           GOBACK.

       END PROGRAM MAX-SUM-INCREASING-SUBSEQ.

       IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. LARGE-PRODUCT.

       ENVIRONMENT DIVISION.

       INPUT-OUTPUT SECTION.

       DATA DIVISION.

       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.

       01 WS-PRODUCTS.
           05 WS-PROD OCCURS 36 TIMES PIC S9(18).
       01 WS-I PIC 9(4) VALUE 0.
       01 WS-J PIC 9(4) VALUE 0.
       01 WS-K PIC 9(4) VALUE 0.
       01 WS-TEMP PIC S9(18) VALUE 0.

       LINKAGE SECTION.

       01 LINKED-ITEMS.
           05 L-NUMS1 OCCURS 6 TIMES INDEXED BY NI PIC S9(10).
           05 L-NUMS2 OCCURS 6 TIMES INDEXED BY NJ PIC S9(10).
           05 L-N PIC S9(10).
           05 RESULT OCCURS 100 TIMES INDEXED BY NK PIC S9(10).

      * Write a function to find the specified number of largest products from two given lists.
      * >>> large_product([1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6], [3, 6, 8, 9, 10, 6], 3)
      * [60, 54, 50]
      *

       PROCEDURE DIVISION USING LINKED-ITEMS.

       MAIN-LOGIC.
      * Compute all pairwise products
           MOVE 0 TO WS-K
           PERFORM VARYING NI FROM 1 BY 1 UNTIL NI > 6
               PERFORM VARYING NJ FROM 1 BY 1 UNTIL NJ > 6
                   ADD 1 TO WS-K
                   COMPUTE WS-PROD (WS-K) =
                       L-NUMS1 (NI) * L-NUMS2 (NJ)
               END-PERFORM
           END-PERFORM

      * Sort the products in descending order (bubble sort)
           PERFORM VARYING WS-I FROM 1 BY 1 UNTIL WS-I > 35
               PERFORM VARYING WS-J FROM 1 BY 1 UNTIL WS-J > 35
                   IF WS-PROD (WS-J) < WS-PROD (WS-J + 1)
                       MOVE WS-PROD (WS-J) TO WS-TEMP
                       MOVE WS-PROD (WS-J + 1) TO WS-PROD (WS-J)
                       MOVE WS-TEMP TO WS-PROD (WS-J + 1)
                   END-IF
               END-PERFORM
           END-PERFORM

      * Clear the result table
           PERFORM VARYING NK FROM 1 BY 1 UNTIL NK > 100
               MOVE 0 TO RESULT (NK)
           END-PERFORM

      * Copy the L-N largest products into RESULT
           PERFORM VARYING WS-I FROM 1 BY 1 UNTIL WS-I > L-N
               MOVE WS-PROD (WS-I) TO RESULT (WS-I)
           END-PERFORM

           GOBACK.

       END PROGRAM LARGE-PRODUCT.

       IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. GET-MIN-SQUARES.

       ENVIRONMENT DIVISION.

       INPUT-OUTPUT SECTION.

       DATA DIVISION.

       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01 WS-N        PIC S9(18).
       01 WS-I        PIC S9(18).
       01 WS-ROOT     PIC S9(18).
       01 WS-REM      PIC S9(18).
       01 WS-TEMP     PIC S9(18).

           05 L-N PIC S9(10).
           05 RESULT PIC S9(10).

      * Write a python function to find the minimum number of squares whose sum is equal to a
      * given number.
      * >>> get_Min_Squares(6)
      * 3
      * 

      * Complete the WORKING-STORAGE SECTION and the PROCEDURE DIVISION
      * Store the result in the RESULT variable and mark the end of your program with END PROGRAM

       PROCEDURE DIVISION USING LINKED-ITEMS.
           MOVE L-N TO WS-N
           IF WS-N <= 0
               MOVE 0 TO RESULT
               GOBACK
           END-IF
      * Compute the integer square root of N
           MOVE 0 TO WS-ROOT
           PERFORM UNTIL (WS-ROOT + 1) * (WS-ROOT + 1) > WS-N
               ADD 1 TO WS-ROOT
           END-PERFORM
      * Case 1: N is itself a perfect square
           IF WS-ROOT * WS-ROOT = WS-N
               MOVE 1 TO RESULT
               GOBACK
           END-IF
      * Case 4: N is of the form 4^a * (8b + 7)
           MOVE WS-N TO WS-TEMP
           PERFORM UNTIL FUNCTION MOD(WS-TEMP, 4) NOT = 0
               COMPUTE WS-TEMP = WS-TEMP / 4
           END-PERFORM
           IF FUNCTION MOD(WS-TEMP, 8) = 7
               MOVE 4 TO RESULT
               GOBACK
           END-IF
      * Case 2: N is the sum of two squares; otherwise the answer is 3
           MOVE 3 TO RESULT
           MOVE 1 TO WS-I
           PERFORM UNTIL WS-I * WS-I >= WS-N
               COMPUTE WS-REM = WS-N - WS-I * WS-I
               PERFORM UNTIL WS-ROOT * WS-ROOT <= WS-REM
                   SUBTRACT 1 FROM WS-ROOT
               END-PERFORM
               IF WS-ROOT * WS-ROOT = WS-REM
                   MOVE 2 TO RESULT
                   EXIT PERFORM
               END-IF
               ADD 1 TO WS-I
           END-PERFORM
           GOBACK.
       END PROGRAM GET-MIN-SQUARES.

      * Write a python function to find the minimum number of squares whose sum is equal to a

      * Store the result in the RESULT variable and mark the end of your program with END PROGRAM

       PROCEDURE DIVISION USING LINKED-ITEMS.
       MAIN-PARA.
           MOVE L-N TO WS-N
           IF WS-N <= 0
               MOVE 0 TO WS-ANSWER
           ELSE
               PERFORM CHECK-PERFECT-SQUARE
               PERFORM CHECK-TWO-SQUARES
               PERFORM CHECK-FOUR-FORM
               EVALUATE TRUE
                   WHEN WS-SQUARE-FLAG = 'Y'
                       MOVE 1 TO WS-ANSWER
                   WHEN WS-TWO-FLAG = 'Y'
                       MOVE 2 TO WS-ANSWER
                   WHEN WS-FOUR-FLAG = 'Y'
                       MOVE 4 TO WS-ANSWER
                   WHEN OTHER
                       MOVE 3 TO WS-ANSWER
               END-EVALUATE
           END-IF
           MOVE WS-ANSWER TO RESULT
           GOBACK.

       CHECK-PERFECT-SQUARE.
           MOVE 'N' TO WS-SQUARE-FLAG
           PERFORM VARYING WS-P FROM 1 BY 1
               UNTIL WS-P * WS-P > WS-N
                  OR WS-SQUARE-FLAG = 'Y'
               IF WS-P * WS-P = WS-N
                   MOVE 'Y' TO WS-SQUARE-FLAG
               END-IF
           END-PERFORM.

       CHECK-TWO-SQUARES.
           MOVE WS-N TO WS-M
           MOVE 'Y' TO WS-TWO-FLAG
           PERFORM UNTIL FUNCTION MOD(WS-M, 2) NOT = 0
               COMPUTE WS-M = WS-M / 2
           END-PERFORM
           PERFORM VARYING WS-P FROM 3 BY 2

                  OR WS-TWO-FLAG = 'N'
               IF FUNCTION MOD(WS-M, WS-P) = 0
                   MOVE 0 TO WS-COUNT
                   PERFORM UNTIL FUNCTION MOD(WS-M, WS-P) NOT = 0
                       COMPUTE WS-M = WS-M / WS-P

               MOVE 'N' TO WS-TWO-FLAG

           MOVE WS-N TO WS-M
           PERFORM UNTIL FUNCTION MOD(WS-M, 4) NOT = 0
               COMPUTE WS-M = WS-M / 4
           END-PERFORM
           IF FUNCTION MOD(WS-M, 8) = 7
               MOVE 'Y' TO WS-FOUR-FLAG
           ELSE
               MOVE 'N' TO WS-FOUR-FLAG
           END-IF.

       END PROGRAM GET-MIN-SQUARES.

       PROGRAM-ID. FIND-WAYS.

       ENVIRONMENT DIVISION.

       INPUT-OUTPUT SECTION.

       DATA DIVISION.

       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01 WS-N          PIC S9(10).
       01 WS-K          PIC S9(10).
       01 WS-REM        PIC S9(10).
       01 WS-CATALAN    PIC 9(18).

       LINKAGE SECTION.

       01 LINKED-ITEMS.
           05 L-M PIC S9(10).
           05 RESULT PIC S9(10).

      * Write a function to count sequences of given length having non-negative prefix sums that
      * can be generated by given values.
      * >>> find_ways(4)
      * 2
      * 

      * Complete the WORKING-STORAGE SECTION and the PROCEDURE DIVISION
      * Store the result in the RESULT variable and mark the end of your program with END PROGRAM

       PROCEDURE DIVISION USING LINKED-ITEMS.
           IF L-M < 0
               MOVE 0 TO RESULT
           ELSE
               COMPUTE WS-REM = FUNCTION MOD(L-M, 2)
               IF WS-REM NOT = 0
                   MOVE 0 TO RESULT
               ELSE
                   COMPUTE WS-N = L-M / 2
                   MOVE 1 TO WS-CATALAN
                   PERFORM VARYING WS-K FROM 0 BY 1
                       UNTIL WS-K >= WS-N
                       COMPUTE WS-CATALAN =
                           WS-CATALAN * 2 * (2 * WS-K + 1)
                           / (WS-K + 2)
                   END-PERFORM
                   MOVE WS-CATALAN TO RESULT
               END-IF
           END-IF
           GOBACK.
       END PROGRAM FIND-WAYS.

       IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. REARANGE-STRING.

       ENVIRONMENT DIVISION.

       INPUT-OUTPUT SECTION.

       DATA DIVISION.

       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01 WS-LEN         PIC 9(3) VALUE 0.
       01 WS-I           PIC 9(3) VALUE 0.
       01 WS-J           PIC 9(3) VALUE 0.
       01 WS-K           PIC 9(3) VALUE 0.
       01 WS-IDX         PIC 9(3) VALUE 0.
       01 WS-POS         PIC 9(3) VALUE 0.
       01 WS-TMP-CNT     PIC 9(3) VALUE 0.
       01 WS-TMP-LET     PIC X    VALUE SPACE.
       01 WS-BUILD       PIC X(100) VALUE SPACES.
       01 WS-CHAR-TABLE.
           05 WS-ENTRY OCCURS 256 TIMES.
               10 WS-CNT PIC 9(3) VALUE 0.
               10 WS-LET PIC X    VALUE SPACE.

       LINKAGE SECTION.

       01 LINKED-ITEMS.
           05 L-S PIC X(100).
           05 RESULT PIC X(100).

      * Write a function to check if the letters of a given string can be rearranged so that two
      * characters that are adjacent to each other are different.
      * >>> rearange_string('aab')
      * 'aba'
      * 

       PROCEDURE DIVISION USING LINKED-ITEMS.
       MAIN-LOGIC.
           MOVE SPACES TO RESULT
           MOVE SPACES TO WS-BUILD

      * Determine effective length (ignore trailing spaces)
           MOVE 0 TO WS-LEN
           PERFORM VARYING WS-I FROM 100 BY -1 UNTIL WS-I = 0
               IF WS-LEN = 0 AND L-S(WS-I:1) NOT = SPACE
                   MOVE WS-I TO WS-LEN
               END-IF
           END-PERFORM
           IF WS-LEN = 0
               GOBACK
           END-IF

      * Initialize character table
           PERFORM VARYING WS-I FROM 1 BY 1 UNTIL WS-I > 256
               MOVE 0 TO WS-CNT(WS-I)
               MOVE FUNCTION CHAR(WS-I) TO WS-LET(WS-I)
           END-PERFORM

      * Count occurrences of each character
           PERFORM VARYING WS-I FROM 1 BY 1 UNTIL WS-I > WS-LEN
               MOVE FUNCTION ORD(L-S(WS-I:1)) TO WS-IDX
               ADD 1 TO WS-CNT(WS-IDX)
           END-PERFORM

      * Sort characters by frequency (descending)
           PERFORM VARYING WS-I FROM 1 BY 1 UNTIL WS-I > 255
               COMPUTE WS-K = WS-I + 1
               PERFORM VARYING WS-J FROM WS-K BY 1 UNTIL WS-J > 256
                   IF WS-CNT(WS-J) > WS-CNT(WS-I)
                       MOVE WS-CNT(WS-I) TO WS-TMP-CNT
                       MOVE WS-LET(WS-I) TO WS-TMP-LET
                       MOVE WS-CNT(WS-J) TO WS-CNT(WS-I)
                       MOVE WS-LET(WS-J) TO WS-LET(WS-I)
                       MOVE WS-TMP-CNT TO WS-CNT(WS-J)
                       MOVE WS-TMP-LET TO WS-LET(WS-J)
                   END-IF
               END-PERFORM
           END-PERFORM

      * If the most frequent char occurs more than (LEN+1)/2 times,
      * rearrangement is impossible
           IF WS-CNT(1) * 2 > WS-LEN + 1
               MOVE SPACES TO RESULT
               GOBACK
           END-IF

      * Fill positions 1,3,5,... first, then 2,4,6,...
           MOVE 1 TO WS-POS
           PERFORM VARYING WS-I FROM 1 BY 1 UNTIL WS-I > 256
               PERFORM VARYING WS-J FROM 1 BY 1
                       UNTIL WS-J > WS-CNT(WS-I)
                   MOVE WS-LET(WS-I) TO WS-BUILD(WS-POS:1)
                   ADD 2 TO WS-POS
                   IF WS-POS > WS-LEN
                       MOVE 2 TO WS-POS
                   END-IF
               END-PERFORM
           END-PERFORM

           MOVE WS-BUILD TO RESULT
           GOBACK.
       END PROGRAM REARANGE-STRING.

      * Write a function to compute the value of ncr%p.
      * >>> ncr_modp(10, 2, 13)
      * 6
      *

      * Complete the WORKING-STORAGE SECTION and the PROCEDURE DIVISION
      * Store the result in the RESULT variable and mark the end of your program with END PROGRAM

       PROCEDURE DIVISION USING LINKED-ITEMS.
           MOVE L-N TO WS-N
           MOVE L-R TO WS-R
           MOVE L-P TO WS-P

           IF WS-P <= 1
               MOVE 0 TO RESULT
               GOBACK
           END-IF

           IF WS-N < 0 OR WS-R < 0 OR WS-R > WS-N
               MOVE 0 TO RESULT
               GOBACK
           END-IF

      * Use Lucas' theorem: C(n,r) mod p is the product of
      * C(ni,ri) mod p over the base-p digits of n and r.
           MOVE 1 TO WS-RES
           PERFORM UNTIL (WS-N = 0 AND WS-R = 0) OR WS-RES = 0
               COMPUTE WS-NI = FUNCTION MOD(WS-N, WS-P)
               COMPUTE WS-RI = FUNCTION MOD(WS-R, WS-P)

               IF WS-RI > WS-NI
                   MOVE 0 TO WS-RES
               ELSE
      * Compute C(WS-NI, WS-RI) mod p, with 0 <= WS-RI <= WS-NI < p
                   IF WS-RI > WS-NI - WS-RI
                       COMPUTE WS-K = WS-NI - WS-RI
                   ELSE
                       MOVE WS-RI TO WS-K
                   END-IF

                   MOVE 1 TO WS-NUM
                   MOVE 1 TO WS-DEN
                   PERFORM VARYING WS-I FROM 1 BY 1
                       UNTIL WS-I > WS-K
                       COMPUTE WS-NUM = FUNCTION MOD(
                           WS-NUM * (WS-NI - WS-K + WS-I), WS-P)
                       COMPUTE WS-DEN = FUNCTION MOD(
                           WS-DEN * WS-I, WS-P)
                   END-PERFORM

      * Modular inverse of WS-DEN via Fermat's little theorem
                   MOVE WS-DEN TO WS-BASE
                   COMPUTE WS-EXP = WS-P - 2
                   MOVE 1 TO WS-POW
                   PERFORM UNTIL WS-EXP <= 0
                       IF FUNCTION MOD(WS-EXP, 2) = 1
                           COMPUTE WS-POW = FUNCTION MOD(
                               WS-POW * WS-BASE, WS-P)
                       END-IF
                       COMPUTE WS-BASE = FUNCTION MOD(
                           WS-BASE * WS-BASE, WS-P)
                       COMPUTE WS-EXP = FUNCTION INTEGER(WS-EXP / 2)
                   END-PERFORM

                   COMPUTE WS-RES = FUNCTION MOD(
                       FUNCTION MOD(WS-RES * WS-NUM, WS-P) * WS-POW,
                       WS-P)
               END-IF

               COMPUTE WS-N = FUNCTION INTEGER(WS-N / WS-P)
               COMPUTE WS-R = FUNCTION INTEGER(WS-R / WS-P)
           END-PERFORM

           MOVE WS-RES TO RESULT
           GOBACK.

       END PROGRAM NCR-MODP.

       PROGRAM-ID. LARGEST-NEG.

       INPUT-OUTPUT SECTION.

       77 WS-I     PIC 9(4) COMP VALUE 1.
       77 WS-BEST  PIC S9(10) VALUE 0.
       77 WS-FOUND PIC X VALUE 'N'.

       LINKAGE SECTION.

       01 LINKED-ITEMS.
           05 L-LIST1 OCCURS 5 TIMES INDEXED BY NI PIC S9(10).
           05 RESULT PIC S9(10).

      * Write a python function to find the largest negative number from the given list.
      * >>> largest_neg([1, 2, 3, -4, -6])
      * -6
      *

      * Complete the WORKING-STORAGE SECTION and the PROCEDURE DIVISION
      * Store the result in the RESULT variable and mark the end of your program with END PROGRAM

           MOVE 0 TO WS-BEST
           MOVE 'N' TO WS-FOUND
           PERFORM VARYING WS-I FROM 1 BY 1 UNTIL WS-I > 5
               IF L-LIST1(WS-I) < 0
                   IF WS-FOUND = 'N' OR L-LIST1(WS-I) < WS-BEST
                       MOVE L-LIST1(WS-I) TO WS-BEST
                       MOVE 'Y' TO WS-FOUND
                   END-IF
               END-IF
           END-PERFORM
           MOVE WS-BEST TO RESULT
           GOBACK.

                           + L-X3 * (L-Y1 - L-Y2)

           ELSE
               MOVE "Yes" TO RESULT
           END-IF

           GOBACK.

       ENVIRONMENT DIVISION.

       INPUT-OUTPUT SECTION.

       DATA DIVISION.

       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01 WS-NUM        PIC S9(10).
       01 WS-QUOT       PIC S9(10).
       01 WS-REM        PIC S9(10).
       01 WS-OCTAL      PIC S9(10) VALUE 0.
       01 WS-PLACE      PIC S9(10) VALUE 1.
       01 WS-SIGN       PIC S9 VALUE 1.

       LINKAGE SECTION.

       01 LINKED-ITEMS.
           05 L-DECINUM PIC S9(10).
           05 RESULT PIC S9(10).

      * Write a python function to convert decimal number to octal number.
      * >>> decimal_to_Octal(10)
      * 12
      *

      * Complete the WORKING-STORAGE SECTION and the PROCEDURE DIVISION
      * Store the result in the RESULT variable and mark the end of your program with END PROGRAM

       PROCEDURE DIVISION USING LINKED-ITEMS.
           MOVE 0 TO WS-OCTAL
           MOVE 1 TO WS-PLACE
           MOVE 1 TO WS-SIGN
           MOVE L-DECINUM TO WS-NUM
           IF WS-NUM < 0
               MOVE -1 TO WS-SIGN
               COMPUTE WS-NUM = WS-NUM * -1
           END-IF
           PERFORM UNTIL WS-NUM = 0
               DIVIDE WS-NUM BY 8 GIVING WS-QUOT REMAINDER WS-REM
               COMPUTE WS-OCTAL = WS-OCTAL + WS-REM * WS-PLACE
               COMPUTE WS-PLACE = WS-PLACE * 10
               MOVE WS-QUOT TO WS-NUM
           END-PERFORM
           COMPUTE RESULT = WS-OCTAL * WS-SIGN
           GOBACK.
       END PROGRAM DECIMAL-TO-OCTAL.

      * queue algorithm.
      * >>> heap_queue_smallest([25, 35, 22, 85, 14, 65, 75, 25, 58], 3)

      *

      * Store the result in the RESULT variable and mark the end of your program with END PROGRAM

       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01 WS-HEAP.
           05 WS-ITEM OCCURS 9 TIMES INDEXED BY HI PIC S9(10).
       01 WS-SIZE      PIC S9(10) VALUE 0.
       01 WS-I         PIC S9(10) VALUE 0.
       01 WS-J         PIC S9(10) VALUE 0.
       01 WS-K         PIC S9(10) VALUE 0.
       01 WS-PARENT    PIC S9(10) VALUE 0.
       01 WS-CHILD     PIC S9(10) VALUE 0.
       01 WS-TEMP      PIC S9(10) VALUE 0.
       01 WS-DONE      PIC X VALUE 'N'.

       PROCEDURE DIVISION USING LINKED-ITEMS.
       MAIN-LOGIC.
      * Clear the result area
           PERFORM VARYING WS-J FROM 1 BY 1 UNTIL WS-J > 100
               MOVE 0 TO RESULT(WS-J)
           END-PERFORM
      * Copy the input numbers into the heap
           PERFORM VARYING WS-I FROM 1 BY 1 UNTIL WS-I > 9
               MOVE L-NUMS(WS-I) TO WS-ITEM(WS-I)
           END-PERFORM
           MOVE 9 TO WS-SIZE
      * Build the min heap (heapify)
           COMPUTE WS-PARENT = FUNCTION INTEGER(WS-SIZE / 2)
           PERFORM UNTIL WS-PARENT < 1
               MOVE WS-PARENT TO WS-I
               PERFORM SIFT-DOWN
               SUBTRACT 1 FROM WS-PARENT
           END-PERFORM
      * Extract the N smallest elements one by one
           PERFORM VARYING WS-K FROM 1 BY 1
               UNTIL WS-K > L-N OR WS-SIZE < 1
               MOVE WS-ITEM(1) TO RESULT(WS-K)
               MOVE WS-ITEM(WS-SIZE) TO WS-ITEM(1)
               SUBTRACT 1 FROM WS-SIZE
               MOVE 1 TO WS-I
               PERFORM SIFT-DOWN
           END-PERFORM
           GOBACK.

           PERFORM UNTIL WS-DONE = 'Y'

                   IF WS-ITEM(WS-I) <= WS-ITEM(WS-CHILD)

                       MOVE WS-ITEM(WS-CHILD) TO WS-ITEM(WS-I)
                       MOVE WS-TEMP TO WS-ITEM(WS-CHILD)
                       MOVE WS-CHILD TO WS-I

       PROCEDURE DIVISION USING LINKED-ITEMS.
       MAIN-LOGIC.
      * Copy the input numbers into the working heap

      * Build a min-heap (heapify)

               MOVE WS-I TO WS-ROOT
               PERFORM SIFT-DOWN

      * Extract the L-N smallest items from the heap
           PERFORM VARYING WS-I FROM 1 BY 1 UNTIL WS-I > L-N
               MOVE WS-H(1) TO RESULT(WS-I)
               MOVE WS-H(WS-SIZE) TO WS-H(1)
               SUBTRACT 1 FROM WS-SIZE
               IF WS-SIZE > 0
                   MOVE 1 TO WS-ROOT
                   PERFORM SIFT-DOWN
               END-IF
           END-PERFORM

      * Write a function to check for the number of jumps required of given length to reach a
      * point of form (d, 0) from origin in a 2d plane.
      * >>> min_Jumps(3, 4, 0)
      * 0
      *
      * Each jump covers a distance of sqrt(a*a + b*b), so the minimum
      * number of jumps needed to cover distance d is
      * ceil(d / sqrt(a*a + b*b)), i.e. the smallest n with
      * n*n*(a*a + b*b) >= d*d.

       PROCEDURE DIVISION USING LINKED-ITEMS.
           MOVE L-A TO WS-A
           MOVE L-B TO WS-B
           MOVE L-D TO WS-D

           IF WS-A < 0
               COMPUTE WS-A = 0 - WS-A
           END-IF
           IF WS-B < 0
               COMPUTE WS-B = 0 - WS-B
           END-IF
           IF WS-D < 0
               COMPUTE WS-D = 0 - WS-D
           END-IF

           COMPUTE WS-LEN-SQ = WS-A * WS-A + WS-B * WS-B
           COMPUTE WS-D-SQ = WS-D * WS-D

           IF WS-D-SQ = 0 OR WS-LEN-SQ = 0
               MOVE 0 TO RESULT
               GOBACK
           END-IF

      * Estimate n = ceil(d / sqrt(a*a + b*b)) via floating point
           COMPUTE WS-ROOT = FUNCTION SQRT(WS-D-SQ / WS-LEN-SQ)
           COMPUTE WS-N = FUNCTION INTEGER-PART(WS-ROOT)
           IF WS-N < WS-ROOT
               ADD 1 TO WS-N
           END-IF

      * Correct any floating point inaccuracy with exact integer checks
           PERFORM UNTIL WS-N = 0
               OR (WS-N - 1) * (WS-N - 1) * WS-LEN-SQ < WS-D-SQ
               SUBTRACT 1 FROM WS-N
           END-PERFORM
           PERFORM UNTIL WS-N * WS-N * WS-LEN-SQ >= WS-D-SQ
               ADD 1 TO WS-N
           END-PERFORM

           MOVE WS-N TO RESULT
           GOBACK.
       END PROGRAM MIN-JUMPS.

       01 WS-TOKEN          PIC X(100).
       01 WS-EDITED         PIC -(18)9.
       01 WS-NUM            PIC S9(18).
       01 WS-LEN            PIC 9(3) VALUE 0.
       01 WS-I              PIC 9(3).
       01 WS-START          PIC 9(3).
       01 WS-NUMERIC-FLAG   PIC X.

           05 L-TEST-LIST OCCURS 7 TIMES INDEXED BY NI PIC X(100).

      * Write a function to increment the numeric values in the given strings by k.
      * >>> increment_numerics(['MSM', '234', 'is', '98', '123', 'best', '4'], 6)
      * ['MSM', '240', 'is', '104', '129', 'best', '10']
      * 

       PROCEDURE DIVISION USING LINKED-ITEMS.
       MAIN-LOGIC.
           PERFORM VARYING NI FROM 1 BY 1 UNTIL NI > 7
               SET NJ TO NI
               PERFORM PROCESS-ITEM
           END-PERFORM
           GOBACK.

       PROCESS-ITEM.
           MOVE FUNCTION TRIM(L-TEST-LIST(NI)) TO WS-TOKEN
           MOVE 0 TO WS-LEN
           PERFORM VARYING WS-I FROM 1 BY 1
               UNTIL WS-I > 100 OR WS-TOKEN(WS-I:1) = SPACE
               ADD 1 TO WS-LEN
           END-PERFORM
           MOVE 'Y' TO WS-NUMERIC-FLAG
           MOVE 1 TO WS-START
           IF WS-LEN = 0
               MOVE 'N' TO WS-NUMERIC-FLAG
           ELSE
               IF WS-TOKEN(1:1) = '+' OR WS-TOKEN(1:1) = '-'
                   IF WS-LEN = 1
                       MOVE 'N' TO WS-NUMERIC-FLAG
                   ELSE
                       MOVE 2 TO WS-START
                   END-IF
               END-IF
           END-IF
           IF WS-NUMERIC-FLAG = 'Y'
               PERFORM VARYING WS-I FROM WS-START BY 1
                   UNTIL WS-I > WS-LEN
                   IF WS-TOKEN(WS-I:1) < '0'
                       OR WS-TOKEN(WS-I:1) > '9'
                       MOVE 'N' TO WS-NUMERIC-FLAG
                   END-IF
               END-PERFORM
           END-IF
           IF WS-NUMERIC-FLAG = 'Y'
               COMPUTE WS-NUM = FUNCTION NUMVAL(WS-TOKEN) + L-K
               MOVE WS-NUM TO WS-EDITED
               MOVE FUNCTION TRIM(WS-EDITED) TO RESULT(NJ)
           ELSE
               MOVE L-TEST-LIST(NI) TO RESULT(NJ)
           END-IF.

      * 'Valid IP address'

       PROCEDURE DIVISION USING LINKED-ITEMS.

      * Find the length of the address ignoring trailing spaces
           MOVE 0 TO WS-LEN
           PERFORM VARYING WS-I FROM 1 BY 1 UNTIL WS-I > 100
               IF WS-IP(WS-I:1) NOT = SPACE
                   MOVE WS-I TO WS-LEN
               END-IF
           END-PERFORM
           MOVE 'Y' TO WS-VALID
           MOVE 0 TO WS-DOTS
           MOVE 1 TO WS-SEG-START
      * Split on dots and validate each numeric segment
           PERFORM VARYING WS-I FROM 1 BY 1 UNTIL WS-I > WS-LEN
               IF WS-IP(WS-I:1) = '.'
                   COMPUTE WS-SEG-END = WS-I - 1
                   PERFORM CHECK-SEGMENT
                   IF WS-SEG-OK = 'N'
                       MOVE 'N' TO WS-VALID
                   END-IF
                   ADD 1 TO WS-DOTS
                   COMPUTE WS-SEG-START = WS-I + 1
               END-IF
           END-PERFORM
           MOVE WS-LEN TO WS-SEG-END
           PERFORM CHECK-SEGMENT
           IF WS-SEG-OK = 'N'
               MOVE 'N' TO WS-VALID
           END-IF
           IF WS-VALID = 'Y' AND WS-DOTS = 3
               MOVE 'Valid IP address' TO RESULT
           ELSE
               MOVE 'Invalid IP address' TO RESULT
           END-IF
           GOBACK.

           COMPUTE WS-SEG-LEN = WS-SEG-END - WS-SEG-START + 1
           MOVE 'Y' TO WS-SEG-OK

                   WHEN WS-ABS < 100

                   WHEN WS-ABS < 1000
                       MOVE 3 TO WS-DIGITS
                   WHEN WS-ABS < 10000
                       MOVE 4 TO WS-DIGITS
                   WHEN WS-ABS < 100000
                       MOVE 5 TO WS-DIGITS
                   WHEN WS-ABS < 1000000
                       MOVE 6 TO WS-DIGITS
                   WHEN WS-ABS < 10000000
                       MOVE 7 TO WS-DIGITS
                   WHEN WS-ABS < 100000000
                       MOVE 8 TO WS-DIGITS

                       MOVE 9 TO WS-DIGITS
                   WHEN OTHER

       IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. POWER-BASE-SUM.

       ENVIRONMENT DIVISION.

       INPUT-OUTPUT SECTION.

       DATA DIVISION.

       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01 WS-DIGITS.
           05 WS-DIGIT PIC 9 OCCURS 100000 TIMES.
       01 WS-NUM-DIGITS PIC 9(7) VALUE 1.
       01 WS-CARRY PIC 9(18).
       01 WS-PRODUCT PIC 9(18).
       01 WS-REM PIC 9.
       01 WS-I PIC 9(11).
       01 WS-J PIC 9(7).
       01 WS-BASE PIC 9(10).
       01 WS-SUM PIC 9(18) VALUE 0.

       LINKAGE SECTION.

       01 LINKED-ITEMS.
           05 L-BASE PIC S9(10).
           05 L-POWER PIC S9(10).
           05 RESULT PIC S9(10).

      * Write a function to calculate the sum of all digits of the base to the specified power.
      * >>> power_base_sum(2, 100)
      * 115
      *

       PROCEDURE DIVISION USING LINKED-ITEMS.
       MAIN-LOGIC.
           MOVE FUNCTION ABS(L-BASE) TO WS-BASE
           INITIALIZE WS-DIGITS
           MOVE 1 TO WS-DIGIT(1)
           MOVE 1 TO WS-NUM-DIGITS
           PERFORM VARYING WS-I FROM 1 BY 1 UNTIL WS-I > L-POWER
               PERFORM MULTIPLY-BY-BASE
           END-PERFORM
           MOVE 0 TO WS-SUM
           PERFORM VARYING WS-J FROM 1 BY 1 UNTIL WS-J > WS-NUM-DIGITS
               ADD WS-DIGIT(WS-J) TO WS-SUM
           END-PERFORM
           MOVE WS-SUM TO RESULT
           GOBACK.

       MULTIPLY-BY-BASE.
           MOVE 0 TO WS-CARRY
           PERFORM VARYING WS-J FROM 1 BY 1
               UNTIL WS-J > WS-NUM-DIGITS
               COMPUTE WS-PRODUCT =
                   WS-DIGIT(WS-J) * WS-BASE + WS-CARRY
               DIVIDE WS-PRODUCT BY 10
                   GIVING WS-CARRY REMAINDER WS-REM
               MOVE WS-REM TO WS-DIGIT(WS-J)
           END-PERFORM
           PERFORM UNTIL WS-CARRY = 0
               ADD 1 TO WS-NUM-DIGITS
               DIVIDE WS-CARRY BY 10
                   GIVING WS-CARRY REMAINDER WS-REM
               MOVE WS-REM TO WS-DIGIT(WS-NUM-DIGITS)
           END-PERFORM.

       END PROGRAM POWER-BASE-SUM.
```

               MOVE WS-N TO RESULT
           ELSE
      * Find the value of the most significant bit (WS-P)
               MOVE 1 TO WS-P
               PERFORM UNTIL WS-P * 2 > WS-N
                   MULTIPLY WS-P BY 2 GIVING WS-P
               END-PERFORM
      * Remaining value after removing the most significant bit
               SUBTRACT WS-P FROM WS-N GIVING WS-M
      * Least significant bit
               COMPUTE WS-LSB = FUNCTION MOD(WS-M, 2)
      * Middle bits of the original number

      * (WS-P - 2) - WS-MID. Reassemble with first and last bits.
               COMPUTE RESULT =
                   WS-P + (WS-P - 2 - WS-MID) + WS-LSB
           END-IF
           GOBACK.

           MOVE 0 TO WS-ANS
           MOVE 1 TO WS-SIGN

           PERFORM UNTIL WS-M = 0
               MOVE 1 TO WS-POWER
               MOVE 0 TO WS-HALF
               COMPUTE WS-DOUBLED = WS-POWER * 2
               PERFORM UNTIL WS-DOUBLED > WS-M

                   MOVE WS-DOUBLED TO WS-POWER

      * Write a python function to check whether the given strings are rotations of each other
      * or not.
      * >>> are_Rotations('abc', 'cba')
      * False
      *

      * Complete the WORKING-STORAGE SECTION and the PROCEDURE DIVISION
      * Store the result in the RESULT variable and mark the end of your program with END PROGRAM

       PROCEDURE DIVISION USING LINKED-ITEMS.
           MOVE 0 TO RESULT
      * Determine the actual length of the first string
      * (ignore trailing spaces)
           MOVE 100 TO WS-LEN1
           PERFORM UNTIL WS-LEN1 = 0
              OR L-STRING1(WS-LEN1:1) NOT = SPACE
               SUBTRACT 1 FROM WS-LEN1
           END-PERFORM
      * Determine the actual length of the second string
           MOVE 100 TO WS-LEN2
           PERFORM UNTIL WS-LEN2 = 0
              OR L-STRING2(WS-LEN2:1) NOT = SPACE
               SUBTRACT 1 FROM WS-LEN2
           END-PERFORM
      * Rotations must have the same length
           IF WS-LEN1 NOT = WS-LEN2
               MOVE 0 TO RESULT
               GOBACK
           END-IF
      * Two empty strings are rotations of each other
           IF WS-LEN1 = 0
               MOVE 1 TO RESULT
               GOBACK
           END-IF
      * Any rotation of S1 must appear inside S1 concatenated with itself
           MOVE SPACES TO WS-DOUBLE
           STRING L-STRING1(1:WS-LEN1)
                  L-STRING1(1:WS-LEN1)
               INTO WS-DOUBLE
           MOVE 0 TO WS-MATCH
           PERFORM VARYING WS-I FROM 1 BY 1
               UNTIL WS-I > WS-LEN1
               IF WS-DOUBLE(WS-I:WS-LEN2) = L-STRING2(1:WS-LEN2)
                   MOVE 1 TO WS-MATCH
               END-IF
           END-PERFORM
           MOVE WS-MATCH TO RESULT
           GOBACK.
       END PROGRAM ARE-ROTATIONS.

           PERFORM VARYING WS-I FROM 100 BY -1 UNTIL WS-I = 0

       DATA DIVISION.

       01 WS-N          PIC S9(18) COMP-5.
       01 WS-R          PIC S9(18) COMP-5.
       01 WS-P          PIC S9(18) COMP-5.
       01 WS-Q          PIC S9(18) COMP-5.
       01 WS-NI         PIC S9(18) COMP-5.
       01 WS-RI         PIC S9(18) COMP-5.
       01 WS-K          PIC S9(18) COMP-5.
       01 WS-I          PIC S9(18) COMP-5.
       01 WS-NUM        PIC S9(18) COMP-5.
       01 WS-DEN        PIC S9(18) COMP-5.
       01 WS-BASE       PIC S9(18) COMP-5.
       01 WS-EXP        PIC S9(18) COMP-5.
       01 WS-POW        PIC S9(18) COMP-5.
       01 WS-SMALL      PIC S9(18) COMP-5.
       01 WS-RESULT     PIC S9(18) COMP-5.

       LINKAGE SECTION.

       01 LINKED-ITEMS.
           05 L-N PIC S9(10).
           05 L-R PIC S9(10).
           05 L-P PIC S9(10).
           05 RESULT PIC S9(10).

      * Write a function to compute the value of ncr mod p.
      * >>> nCr_mod_p(10, 2, 13)
      * 6
      *
      * Uses Lucas' theorem: C(n,r) mod p is the product of
      * C(ni,ri) mod p over the base-p digits of n and r.
      * Each small C(ni,ri) mod p uses the multiplicative formula
      * with a modular inverse via Fermat's little theorem.

       PROCEDURE DIVISION USING LINKED-ITEMS.
       MAIN-PARA.
           MOVE L-N TO WS-N
           MOVE L-R TO WS-R
           MOVE L-P TO WS-P
           IF WS-N < 0 OR WS-R < 0 OR WS-R > WS-N OR WS-P <= 1
               MOVE 0 TO RESULT
               GOBACK
           END-IF
           MOVE 1 TO WS-RESULT
           PERFORM UNTIL (WS-N = 0 AND WS-R = 0)
               DIVIDE WS-P INTO WS-N GIVING WS-Q REMAINDER WS-NI
               MOVE WS-Q TO WS-N
               DIVIDE WS-P INTO WS-R GIVING WS-Q REMAINDER WS-RI
               MOVE WS-Q TO WS-R
               IF WS-RI > WS-NI
                   MOVE 0 TO WS-RESULT
                   EXIT PERFORM
               END-IF
               PERFORM COMPUTE-SMALL-NCR
               COMPUTE WS-RESULT =
                   FUNCTION MOD(WS-RESULT * WS-SMALL, WS-P)
           END-PERFORM
           MOVE WS-RESULT TO RESULT
           GOBACK.

       COMPUTE-SMALL-NCR.
      *    Compute C(WS-NI, WS-RI) mod WS-P into WS-SMALL
           IF WS-RI > (WS-NI - WS-RI)
               COMPUTE WS-K = WS-NI - WS-RI
           ELSE
               MOVE WS-RI TO WS-K
           END-IF
           MOVE 1 TO WS-NUM
           MOVE 1 TO WS-DEN
           PERFORM VARYING WS-I FROM 1 BY 1 UNTIL WS-I > WS-K
               COMPUTE WS-NUM = FUNCTION MOD(
                   WS-NUM * (WS-NI - WS-K + WS-I), WS-P)
               COMPUTE WS-DEN = FUNCTION MOD(WS-DEN * WS-I, WS-P)
           END-PERFORM
      *    Modular inverse of WS-DEN: WS-DEN ** (WS-P - 2) mod WS-P
           MOVE WS-DEN TO WS-BASE
           COMPUTE WS-EXP = WS-P - 2
           MOVE 1 TO WS-POW
           PERFORM UNTIL WS-EXP <= 0
               IF FUNCTION MOD(WS-EXP, 2) = 1
                   COMPUTE WS-POW =
                       FUNCTION MOD(WS-POW * WS-BASE, WS-P)
               END-IF
               COMPUTE WS-BASE =
                   FUNCTION MOD(WS-BASE * WS-BASE, WS-P)
               DIVIDE 2 INTO WS-EXP GIVING WS-EXP
           END-PERFORM
           COMPUTE WS-SMALL = FUNCTION MOD(WS-NUM * WS-POW, WS-P)
           .

       END PROGRAM NCR-MOD-P.
